name: Enlightened Philosopher
summary: The enlightened philosopher seeks enlightenment through compassion, moderation, and humility.
replacesText: Mystery Class Skills; Mystery Bonus Spells; 7th-level Revelation; Final Revelation

features.name: Recommended Mysteries
features.summary: ancestor, fire, heavens, lore, metal, nature, stone, time, waves, wood.

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: An enlightened philosopher adds Linguistics and all Knowledge skills to her list of class skills. These replace the additional class skills from her mystery.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.summary: owl’s wisdom (4th), water walk (6th), discern lies (8th), true seeing (10th), wind walk (12th), ethereal jaunt (14th), moment of prescience (16th), astral projection (18th). These bonus spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels.

features.name: Mental Acuity (Ex)
features.summary: Gain a +1 inherent bonus to Intelligence at 7th level. Increase it by 1 for every three additional oracle levels.

features.name: Final Revelation
features.summary: Upon achieving 20th level, you achieve true enlightenment and become one with the universe. You receive a bonus on all saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier. You become immune to confusion, exhaustion, fatigue, nausea, and sickened effects. You can take 20 on all Knowledge skill checks. Should you die, you are reborn 3 days later as a living example of the summoning of your chosen philosophy (treat as the reincarnate spell). This replaces the final revelation of the oracle’s mystery.

featureOverrides.summary: Choose a mystery for its first bonus spell and remaining revelations. Enlightened Philosopher supplies its own additional class skills and final revelation.

mechanicalNotes: The final revelation’s automatic reincarnation after three days is tracked as a descriptive rule.
